name: list_adb_packages
description: List installed packages on one device with each base APK's device path, optionally scoped to third-party or system packages. Paths are device filesystem paths, not host-local. Read-only.

serial.description: Device serial exactly as `adb devices` reports it

scope.description: Package scope: all packages, third-party only (-3), or system only (-s)

__schema0.description: Device serial exactly as `adb devices` reports it

__schema1.description: Package scope: all packages, third-party only (-3), or system only (-s)
